name: LaunchDarkly MCP
description: Gives coding agents a hosted OAuth MCP server to create and target LaunchDarkly feature flags, manage AgentControl configs, and query observability data.

skills.name: Feature Flag Management
skills.description: Creates feature flags, turns them on or off across environments, and updates targeting rules from natural-language prompts.

skills.name: AgentControl Configs
skills.description: Creates, reads, updates, and deletes AgentControl configs in LaunchDarkly projects through the hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Observability Queries
skills.description: Queries logs, traces, error groups, and the Dashboards page, for example listing error groups from the last 24 hours.

skills.name: Flag Cleanup Readiness
skills.description: Classifies a flag as safe, caution, or not-ready for removal across environments, with evidence, before code cleanup.
